messages:
nina (docs): Quick sync — we have a multi-PR docs refactor that will momentarily break anchors if not sequenced. PRs: #4510 move migration -> /guides/migrate.md, #4515 rename examples + redirects, #4519 SDK snippet updates. Deploy preview for #4510 shows a missing anchor: https://deploy-preview-4510--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/migrate.html#step-3

carlos (eng): Yep. The usual race: move first, preview fails because redirect absent. Prefer the pattern: temporary redirect PR -> merge -> move -> cleanup -> snippet PR.

ivy (platform): I can open a one-line redirect PR (#4522) and flip link-checker to WARN-only during the window if needed. Also can purge CDN after merges.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4510 failed: 1 broken link -> /guides/migrate.html#step-3

nina (docs): Proposed order: 1) ivy opens #4522 (temporary redirect) and we merge it, 2) merge #4510 (move), 3) merge #4515 (rename + cleanup), 4) merge #4519 (snippets). Requesting reviewers: @carlos for #4510 and @ben for #4519. Target window: today 11:30–12:00 PT. Objections?

ben (docs): I'll review #4519. I'll add backward-compatible examples for renamed helpers to avoid breaking existing code samples.

carlos (eng): Fine. Local repro: run `yarn docs:build && ./scripts/link-check` to see the same missing anchor error: "Missing anchor 'step-3' in migrate.md"

ivy (platform): #4522 created (WIP) with mapping `/guides/migrate.html -> /guides/migrate/overview.html`. I'll mark it urgent and schedule a WARN-only flip for 10 minutes around 11:35 PT. If redirects don't show in preview, we may need to merge the temporary redirect twice (race).

nina (docs): I'll add `docs/merge-window` label and update PR descriptions with the merge sequence and rollback notes. After each merge we'll run `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url <deploy-preview>` to validate anchors. If anything breaks, revert the last merge and purge CDN for the route.

carlos (eng): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby to approve #4510 at 11:32 PT. Please ping here 10 minutes before.

ivy (platform): Redirect merged now. CI shows preview for redirect PR green. I'll post when WARN flip is live if we need it.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4522 successful: no broken links detected

nina (docs): Perfect — proceeding to merge #4510 next. Carlos, please review and I'll run the smoke script after merge.

ben (docs): Good plan. After all merges, let's run a full site link-check and add a short playbook doc for this pattern so it's easier next time.

nina (docs): Agreed. I'll create a tiny playbook PR after this cascade. Thanks team.
